title.zh: 将指定终端用户从频道踢出
title.en: Kick Specified End Users from a Channel

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
本接口用于将指定终端用户从频道踢出。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes

This API removes specified end users from a channel.

# QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 1,000 calls per minute per user. If you exceed the limit, API calls are subject to rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this API at a reasonable rate. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~341645~~).
